panels.title: Data through
panels.description:
Last day included in this load (the nightly window ends at 23:59 UTC that day).

**Source:** n360.runs, written by load.py only after every data check passes  
**Filter:** loaded runs only; the latest  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:
SELECT formatDateTime(window_end, '%e %b %Y') AS data_through
        FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded' ORDER BY loaded_at DESC, data_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Last night
panels.description:
Result of the latest nightly run. A stopped night leaves the previous good night on screen.

**Source:** n360.runs (load.py writes one row per night, loaded or not)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest run

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(status) AS status FROM n360.runs ORDER BY loaded_at DESC, data_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Tickets
panels.description:
Support tickets opened in the time range. Tags (product area, ask) are set by hand, never automatically. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range (opened)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS Opened, countIf(status = 'open') AS `Still open`, countIf(product_area IS NULL) AS `Not tagged yet`
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(opened)

panels.title: Top asks
panels.description:
Asks wanted by several customers (2 or more, proposed).

**Source:** n360.v_top_asks  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS asks FROM n360.v_top_asks

panels.title: Tickets by product area
panels.description:
Tickets opened in the time range by product area. "Not tagged yet" is a real bucket, not a guess. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range (opened)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ifNull(product_area, 'Not tagged yet') AS Area, count() AS Tickets
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(opened) GROUP BY Area ORDER BY Tickets DESC

panels.title: Top asks: several customers wanting the same thing
panels.description:
Asks tagged on tickets from 2 or more customers (proposed). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_top_asks  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.ask AS Ask, t.customers AS Customers, t.tickets AS Tickets,
               arrayStringConcat(t.account_list, ', ') AS Which, t.last_asked AS `Last asked`
        FROM n360.v_top_asks AS t ORDER BY Customers DESC, Tickets DESC

defaults.noValue: No ask shared by several customers

panels.title: Tickets by customer
panels.description:
Tickets opened in the time range per customer. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range (opened)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ac.display_name AS Customer, count() AS Tickets
        FROM n360.ps_ticket AS t INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = t.account
        WHERE t.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(t.opened) GROUP BY Customer ORDER BY Tickets DESC

panels.title: Not tagged yet
panels.description:
Tickets with no product area yet. They are tagged by hand, never automatically. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer; product area empty  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.ticket_id AS Ticket, ac.display_name AS Customer, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(t.opened)), ' ', formatDateTime(t.opened, '%b %Y')) AS Opened, t.title AS Title,
               t.status AS Status
        FROM n360.ps_ticket AS t INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = t.account
        WHERE t.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND t.product_area IS NULL ORDER BY t.opened
